notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
-Hiding 'make public' for anyone but the host of the lobby
-Now zooms in on correct player when picking hat in lobby
-Fixed name size in end screen to avoid overlap
-Better feedback when successfully tagging someone
-Greater angle of freedom for camera, can now look up, etc
-Obstacles become transparent when obstructing the player, instead of zooming the camera in
-Fixed tagging animation in Chase-gamemode
-Fixed sync issue of selected map in online lobby
